Qloo taste data did not reliably predict where an unserved Korean cafe should open. Raw taste reached AUC 0.653, while existing restaurant count reached 0.742. Peer-lift taste reached 0.579 and beat restaurant count for only 1 of 14 cuisines. Korean presence itself fell from AUC 0.893 to 0.693 when blocks within 500 m of Korean restaurants were excluded.

Use Qloo for audience and positioning—not site selection. For the lease, rely on city-records lease scores, competition, traffic, and recent openings.
